messages:
jenny_acme: Hey team — we started seeing customers get different answers in the same chat session after yesterday's model rollout. Example attached, two consecutive messages in same session returned different facts. This started at ~10:15PT.

olivia: Logged it, thanks. Can you paste the two responses + request IDs?

jenny_acme: Sure — session_id=acme-6734. Request IDs: r-3a1f and r-3a20. Responses: 
---
User: 'What is the official support email for Acme?'
r-3a1f -> 'support@acme.example'
r-3a20 -> 'help@acme.example'
---
They're semantically similar but one is wrong for our config.

sam: Yikes. Are these both within a single streaming response or two separate generations?

jenny_acme: Two separate generations in the same session, same conversation state. No retries.

olivia: Can you confirm if you had any routing flags set (prefer_low_cost / prefer_latency) or pinned variants?

jenny_acme: No flags changed. We use sessionAffinity=true on our side. No obvious retries.

sam: @olivia I'll pull routing logs for tenant acme-6734. @jenny_acme can you share the exact curl you used (headers) so we can match trace ids?

jenny_acme: Posting snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME' \
  -H 'X-Tenant-ID: acme-6734' \
  -d '{"session_id":"acme-6734","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the official support email for Acme?"}],"stream":false}'
```
Request IDs above are from our logs.

sam: Pulling routing trace now. eng-bot:trace r-3a1f,r-3a20

eng-bot: routing-trace: r-3a1f -> variant:redwood-v1.2 (region us-west), r-3a20 -> variant:opt-lite-v0.9 (region us-west).

olivia: So the platform routed two requests from same session to different model variants. That explains inconsistent outputs. Need to find why sessionAffinity did not hold.

liam: Possible causes: autoscaler moved requests during instance recycle, or a fallback happened due to an overloaded node and policy allowed fallback to cheaper variant.

sam: I'm seeing a fallback event at 10:15:23 where pool us-west-2/gpu-pool-7 reported high queued latency and routing policy allowed fallback to compatible variant opt-lite-v0.9 per policy rule FallbackOnLatencyHigh.

jenny_acme: Is that expected? Those fallbacks are supposed to be per-request not per-session, right? It breaks session continuity.

olivia: Right — we aim for session affinity at routing layer. Current policy prioritizes latency SLO and can fallback; but session affinity should pin the session to a host for the duration of session TTL (default 30m). Looks like the affinity mapping was lost when the original host was removed from the pool.

liam: Host eviction scenario: when an instance terminates during scaling, affinity keys are not migrated. We attempted to mitigate by routing remaining requests for the session to other hosts in same variant; fallback permits cross-variant routing. Edge case: if variant capacity is zero, fallback policy kicks in.

sam: Action items I propose:
1) Short-term: Pin tenant to redwood-v1.2 for acme-6734 (force variant=redwood-v1.2) until we stabilize.
2) Medium: Disable cross-variant fallback for sessions that have sessionAffinity set.
3) Long-term: Add affinity reconciliation on instance pool scale-down to reassign sessions.

olivia: +1. Also need to notify legal/security if we force pin variant (customer data).

jenny_acme: Pinning sounds good for us. Please confirm ETA. This is impacting support app accuracy.

liam: I'll open a dedicated rollout revert and pin request. ETA: 2 hours to pin and verify logs; will keep you updated.

sam: I'm attaching the minimal repro steps for eng runtime team:
1) Create a session with session_id=test-123 and send a prompt that depends on tenant config.
2) Induce variant capacity drop (simulate node drain) while session active.
3) Send second prompt, observe routing trace to different variant and changed output.

olivia: Filed as SUP-2147. Assigning to eng-runtime.

eng-bot: incident-log SUP-2147 created by olivia. Priority: P2.

jenny_acme: Thanks all. Please keep me posted in this thread.

olivia: Update: pinned acme-6734 to redwood-v1.2 at 11:32PT, verified 20 subsequent requests stayed on variant. We'll monitor for 24h.

jenny_acme: Confirmed. Outputs back to expected. Thanks! :thumbsup:
